keyPoints.en: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang were rich in tin, and Pahang also in gold.
keyPoints.bm: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan dan Pahang kaya dengan bijih timah, dan Pahang juga dengan emas.

keyPoints.en: Tin had been mined for centuries — used as currency in Melaka and traded under Dutch monopolies.
keyPoints.bm: Bijih timah dilombong sejak berabad-abad — digunakan sebagai mata wang di Melaka dan didagangkan di bawah monopoli Belanda.

keyPoints.en: In the 19th century big tin fields opened at Larut and Kinta (Perak), Klang and Lukut (Selangor) and Sungai Ujong (Negeri Sembilan), worked by Chinese miners.
keyPoints.bm: Pada abad ke-19 kawasan bijih timah yang besar dibuka di Larut dan Kinta (Perak), Klang dan Lukut (Selangor) serta Sungai Ujong (Negeri Sembilan), diusahakan pelombong Cina.

meaning.en: Tin field in Perak opened by Long Jaafar (1840s); centre of the Larut Wars.
meaning.bm: Kawasan bijih timah di Perak yang dibuka oleh Long Jaafar (1840-an); pusat Perang Larut.

meaning.en: Long carried out in Pahang (e.g. Raub); later by Western companies.
meaning.bm: Lama dijalankan di Pahang (cth. Raub); kemudian oleh syarikat Barat.

points.en: 15th century: tin coins and ingots used in Melaka's trade.
points.bm: Abad ke-15: syiling dan jongkong timah digunakan dalam perdagangan Melaka.

points.en: 16th–17th centuries: Western traders (especially the Dutch) sought tin from Perak.
points.bm: Abad ke-16 hingga ke-17: pedagang Barat (terutamanya Belanda) mendapatkan bijih timah dari Perak.

points.en: 18th–19th centuries: Chinese capital and labour expanded mining; demand rose with the canning industry.
points.bm: Abad ke-18 hingga ke-19: modal dan buruh Cina meluaskan perlombongan; permintaan meningkat dengan industri mengetin.

points.en: Gold was mined in Pahang from the 16th–17th centuries; in the 19th century Western companies opened mines such as at Raub.
points.bm: Emas dilombong di Pahang sejak abad ke-16 hingga ke-17; pada abad ke-19 syarikat Barat membuka lombong seperti di Raub.

question.en: Why did the wealth of the west-coast states attract British interest?
question.bm: Mengapakah kekayaan negeri pantai barat menarik minat British?

answer.en: Their tin was needed by British industry and the Straits merchants had invested heavily in the mines.
answer.bm: Bijih timahnya diperlukan industri British dan pedagang Negeri-negeri Selat telah melabur dengan banyak dalam lombong.

keyPoints.en: The British expanded their power using manipulation, pressure and agreements with local rulers.
keyPoints.bm: British meluaskan kuasa melalui manipulasi, desakan dan perjanjian dengan pemerintah tempatan.

keyPoints.en: Perak: the Pangkor Treaty (20 January 1874) recognised Raja Abdullah as Sultan and brought a British Resident.
keyPoints.bm: Perak: Perjanjian Pangkor (20 Januari 1874) mengiktiraf Raja Abdullah sebagai Sultan dan membawa Residen British.

keyPoints.en: Selangor accepted a Resident in 1875, Pahang in 1888 and the united Negeri Sembilan in 1895.
keyPoints.bm: Selangor menerima Residen pada 1875, Pahang pada 1888 dan Negeri Sembilan yang bersatu pada 1895.

keyPoints.en: Under the Residential System, the Resident's advice had to be followed except on Islam and Malay custom.
keyPoints.bm: Di bawah Sistem Residen, nasihat Residen mesti dipatuhi kecuali dalam hal agama Islam dan adat Melayu.

meaning.en: 1874 treaty that began British intervention in Perak.
meaning.bm: Perjanjian 1874 yang memulakan campur tangan British di Perak.

meaning.en: British officer whose "advice" the ruler had to accept.
meaning.bm: Pegawai British yang "nasihat"nya mesti diterima raja.

meaning.en: Fighting between Chinese secret societies (Ghee Hin, Hai San) over tin, mixed with a Perak succession dispute.
meaning.bm: Pertempuran antara kongsi gelap Cina (Ghee Hin, Hai San) kerana bijih timah, bercampur dengan perebutan takhta Perak.

points.en: Perak: Britain backed Raja Abdullah in the succession dispute in return for accepting a Resident.
points.bm: Perak: British menyokong Raja Abdullah dalam perebutan takhta sebagai balasan menerima Residen.

points.en: Sungai Ujong: Britain supported Dato' Kelana against his rival.
points.bm: Sungai Ujong: British menyokong Dato' Kelana menentang saingannya.

points.en: Selangor: after a piracy incident, Sultan Abdul Samad was pressed to accept British protection.
points.bm: Selangor: selepas peristiwa lanun, Sultan Abdul Samad didesak menerima perlindungan British.

points.en: Pahang: after the killing of a British subject (1888), Sultan Ahmad was forced to accept a Resident.
points.bm: Pahang: selepas pembunuhan seorang rakyat British (1888), Sultan Ahmad dipaksa menerima Residen.

points.en: Pangkor Treaty (1874), British–Sungai Ujong (1874), British–Selangor, British–Pahang (1887–1888), British–Negeri Sembilan (1889, 1895).
points.bm: Perjanjian Pangkor (1874), British–Sungai Ujong (1874), British–Selangor, British–Pahang (1887–1888), British–Negeri Sembilan (1889, 1895).

points.en: Role of the Resident: advise the ruler on all matters except Islam and Malay custom; collect taxes; keep order.
points.bm: Peranan Residen: menasihati raja dalam semua perkara kecuali agama Islam dan adat Melayu; memungut cukai; menjaga keamanan.

points.en: Implementation: State Councils were set up; J.W.W. Birch (Perak) acted harshly and was killed at Pasir Salak (1875).
points.bm: Pelaksanaan: Majlis Mesyuarat Negeri ditubuhkan; J.W.W. Birch (Perak) bertindak keras dan dibunuh di Pasir Salak (1875).

event.en: Selangor Resident; Birch killed at Pasir Salak.
event.bm: Residen Selangor; Birch dibunuh di Pasir Salak.

event.en: Negeri Sembilan united under a Resident.
event.bm: Negeri Sembilan bersatu di bawah Residen.

question.en: Explain the meaning of the Residential System.

answer.en: A system in which the ruler accepted a British Resident whose advice had to be followed in all matters except Islam and Malay custom — in practice the Resident held real power.
answer.bm: Sistem apabila raja menerima Residen British yang nasihatnya mesti dipatuhi dalam semua perkara kecuali agama Islam dan adat Melayu — secara praktiknya Residen memegang kuasa sebenar.

tip.en: Remember the three strategies: Manipulasi, Desakan, Perjanjian.
tip.bm: Ingat tiga strategi: Manipulasi, Desakan, Perjanjian.

keyPoints.en: The Federated Malay States (FMS) were formed on 1 July 1896: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang.
keyPoints.bm: Negeri-negeri Melayu Bersekutu (NNMB) dibentuk pada 1 Julai 1896: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan dan Pahang.

keyPoints.en: A Resident-General in Kuala Lumpur headed the federation; the first was Frank Swettenham.
keyPoints.bm: Seorang Residen Jeneral di Kuala Lumpur mengetuai persekutuan; yang pertama ialah Frank Swettenham.

keyPoints.en: Reasons: uniform administration, help for poor Pahang, faster development and better defence.
keyPoints.bm: Sebab: pentadbiran seragam, membantu Pahang yang miskin, pembangunan lebih pesat dan pertahanan lebih baik.

meaning.en: Federated Malay States (1896), with a central government in Kuala Lumpur.
meaning.bm: Negeri-negeri Melayu Bersekutu (1896), dengan kerajaan pusat di Kuala Lumpur.

meaning.en: Head of the FMS administration, answering to the High Commissioner (the Governor of the Straits Settlements).
meaning.bm: Ketua pentadbiran NNMB, bertanggungjawab kepada Pesuruhjaya Tinggi (Gabenor Negeri-negeri Selat).

meaning.en: Gathering power in one central government.
meaning.bm: Mengumpulkan kuasa dalam satu kerajaan pusat.

points.en: Resident-General in Kuala Lumpur; a Resident in each state.
points.bm: Residen Jeneral di Kuala Lumpur; seorang Residen di setiap negeri.

points.en: Federal departments (e.g. police, public works, railways) run from Kuala Lumpur.
points.bm: Jabatan persekutuan (cth. polis, kerja raya, kereta api) ditadbir dari Kuala Lumpur.

points.en: Rulers kept authority only over Islam and Malay custom.
points.bm: Raja-raja hanya berkuasa dalam hal agama Islam dan adat Melayu.

points.en: Each state ran differently — a federation made rules uniform.
points.bm: Setiap negeri ditadbir berbeza — persekutuan menyeragamkan peraturan.

points.en: Pahang was in debt and unrest; richer states could help it.
points.bm: Pahang berhutang dan bergolak; negeri yang lebih kaya boleh membantunya.

points.en: Better coordination of roads, railways and economic development; stronger defence.
points.bm: Penyelarasan jalan raya, kereta api dan pembangunan ekonomi yang lebih baik; pertahanan yang lebih kukuh.

question.en: How did forming the FMS affect the Malay rulers?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah pembentukan NNMB memberi kesan kepada raja-raja Melayu?

answer.en: Power moved from the states to the Resident-General in Kuala Lumpur, so the rulers lost even more authority.
answer.bm: Kuasa berpindah dari negeri kepada Residen Jeneral di Kuala Lumpur, maka raja-raja kehilangan lebih banyak kuasa.

keyPoints.en: Each FMS state had a State Council; above them stood the federal government in Kuala Lumpur.
keyPoints.bm: Setiap negeri NNMB mempunyai Majlis Mesyuarat Negeri; di atasnya ialah kerajaan persekutuan di Kuala Lumpur.

keyPoints.en: The Durbar (Conference of Rulers) first met at Kuala Kangsar in 1897.
keyPoints.bm: Durbar (Persidangan Raja-raja) pertama kali bersidang di Kuala Kangsar pada 1897.

keyPoints.en: A Federal Council was set up in 1909 to make laws for the FMS.
keyPoints.bm: Majlis Mesyuarat Persekutuan ditubuhkan pada 1909 untuk menggubal undang-undang NNMB.

meaning.en: Council of the ruler, Resident, Malay chiefs and Chinese leaders in each state.
meaning.bm: Majlis raja, Residen, pembesar Melayu dan pemimpin Cina di setiap negeri.

meaning.en: Meeting of the FMS rulers with British officials.
meaning.bm: Persidangan raja-raja NNMB bersama pegawai British.

meaning.en: 1909 law-making council chaired by the High Commissioner.
meaning.bm: Majlis pembuat undang-undang 1909 yang dipengerusikan Pesuruhjaya Tinggi.

points.en: High Commissioner → Resident-General → Residents → District Officers → penghulu.
points.bm: Pesuruhjaya Tinggi → Residen Jeneral → Residen → Pegawai Daerah → penghulu.

points.en: Members: the High Commissioner (chair), the Resident-General, the four rulers, the four Residents and four unofficial members.
points.bm: Anggota: Pesuruhjaya Tinggi (pengerusi), Residen Jeneral, empat orang raja, empat orang Residen dan empat ahli tidak rasmi.

points.en: The rulers could not veto laws, so their power fell further.
points.bm: Raja-raja tidak boleh membatalkan undang-undang, maka kuasa mereka semakin berkurang.

points.en: First Durbar 1897 (Kuala Kangsar); second 1903 (Kuala Lumpur), where Sultan Idris of Perak asked for more Malays in the government.
points.bm: Durbar pertama 1897 (Kuala Kangsar); kedua 1903 (Kuala Lumpur), apabila Sultan Idris Perak meminta lebih ramai orang Melayu dalam pentadbiran.

question.en: Why did the Federal Council 1909 reduce the power of the Malay rulers?
question.bm: Mengapakah Majlis Mesyuarat Persekutuan 1909 mengurangkan kuasa raja-raja Melayu?

answer.en: Laws for all four states were made by the Federal Council, where the rulers were ordinary members without the power to veto.
answer.bm: Undang-undang bagi keempat-empat negeri dibuat oleh Majlis Mesyuarat Persekutuan, tempat raja-raja hanya ahli biasa tanpa kuasa membatalkan.
